verified_facts.text: The resort is a seaside luxury resort blending Eastern and Western design, beside the waters of the gulf.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Hua Hin Resort is a seaside luxury resort blending Eastern and Western design, alongside sparkling gulf waters.

verified_facts.text: The resort has two accommodation wings with spacious rooms and suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two accommodation wings feature spacious rooms and suites

verified_facts.text: The infinity-edge pool is surrounded by lush greenery and overlooks the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by lush greenery and overlooking the ocean, our 55-metre infinity-edge pool is a design masterpiece.

verified_facts.text: At the pool, guests can lounge on in-pool beds in the shallows, relax in sheltered pavilions or use the Jacuzzi pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lounge in the shallows on an in-pool bed, relax in one of our sheltered pavilions or sit back and enjoy the bubbles in our Jacuzzi pools.

verified_facts.text: Museo Auto Classica at the resort exhibits a curated collection of over 40 classic automobiles.
verified_facts.excerpt: The exhibition features a thoughtfully curated collection of over 40 classic automobiles

verified_facts.text: Museo Auto Classica's exhibits are enhanced by artworks, including paintings by National Artists.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enhancing the experience are exquisite artworks, including paintings by National Artists and distinguished senior artists.

verified_facts.text: The Art Botanic Garden is a lush garden designed as a living canvas with artistic touches for the whole family.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed as a living canvas, the garden provides artistic touches for everyone in a family.

verified_facts.text: The resort's top-tier accommodations feature lush surrounding grounds, a private pool and private beach access.
verified_facts.excerpt: our most exclusive and luxurious accommodations, featuring lush surrounding grounds, private pool, and private beach access.

verified_facts.text: Garden Wing rooms have a private balcony and a marble-floored bathroom with a separate shower and bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms are thoughtfully designed with exceptional features such as a private balcony, a luxurious marble-floored bathroom equipped with a separate shower and bathtub

verified_facts.text: All rooms include one-time access to the Vana Nava water park per stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms include 1-time access to Vana Nava water park per stay.

verified_facts.text: SPA InterContinental is a spa by the sea that welcomes guests with a refreshing towel, a herbal drink and a mini fruit stick set.
verified_facts.excerpt: SPA InterContinental Hua Hin welcomes you with a refreshing towel, a herbal drink, and a mini fruit stick set

verified_facts.text: The spa is set by the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: enter the sanctuary of our tranquil spa by the sea

verified_facts.text: Jaras is a beachside restaurant serving modern Thai cuisine inspired by traditional recipes, overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.
verified_facts.excerpt: showcasing modern Thai cuisine inspired by traditional recipes

verified_facts.text: Azure is a beachfront seafood and Italian restaurant led by Executive Chef Mario Caramella.
verified_facts.excerpt: Azure is a beachfront seafood and Italian restaurant in Hua Hin, serving the freshest local seafood and authentic Italian cuisine. Led by Executive Chef Mario Caramella

verified_facts.text: CoCco Bar is a beach venue serving Thai-inspired drinks in an Art Deco-inspired setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience a lifestyle beach venue in Hua Hin featuring Thai inspired drinks in a distinctive Art Deco inspired setting.

verified_facts.text: BluPort Mall is directly adjacent to the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Directly adjacent to InterContinental Hua Hin, BluPort Mall provides hours of entertainment

verified_facts.text: Hua Hin Beach was originally the preserve of the aristocracy, who came to Hua Hin as an escape from Bangkok.
verified_facts.excerpt: It was originally the preserve of the aristocracy, who would venture down to Hua Hin as an escape from Bangkok.

verified_facts.text: Hua Hin is a beach town known for its sandy beaches, temples, golf courses and hillside vineyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hua Hin is a beach town known for its pristine sandy beaches, cultural attractions and temples, world-class golf courses, and hillside vineyards.

verified_facts.text: Dogs and cats under 20 kilograms are allowed in Classic Rooms, the 1 Bedroom Beachfront Villa and the 3 Bedroom La Residence.
verified_facts.excerpt: Up to 2 pets, dogs or cats, per guest booking with a weight of less than 20 kgs are allowed at Classic Rooms, 1 Bedroom Beachfront Villa, and 3 Bedrooms La Residence.

verified_facts.text: The resort is about 245 kilometers from Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: approximately 152.24 miles away (245 kilometers) from the hotel

verified_facts.text: Club InterContinental guests have access to the Club Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience our exclusive and exquisite Club Lounge.

verified_facts.text: The resort is a single-use plastic free hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Single-use plastic free hotel

verified_facts.excerpt:
